name: zwift-live-prototype

scripts.build:ble: mkdir -p .build/CyclingOSZwiftBLE.app/Contents/MacOS && cp mac-ble/Info.plist .build/CyclingOSZwiftBLE.app/Contents/Info.plist && xcrun swiftc mac-ble/ZwiftLivePeripheral.swift -o .build/CyclingOSZwiftBLE.app/Contents/MacOS/CyclingOSZwiftBLE
